floor_display_names: Second Floor — Guest and Private Level
keep_structure.grid: 48 columns × 32 rows per floor; 5 feet per orthogonal square; diagonal movement disabled.

room_cards.name: Cellar
room_cards.function: Wine, preserved food, salted meat, roots, barrels, and secure caged storage beneath the service wing and Grand Hall.

room_cards.name: Foyer
room_cards.function: Fortified entrance chamber and cooperative-mode starting room.

room_cards.name: Grand Hall
room_cards.function: Double-height center of the keep with split staircase, upper landing, and balcony.

room_cards.name: Game Room
room_cards.function: Public gaming and trophy chamber near the entrance.

room_cards.name: Dining Room
room_cards.function: Everyday dining chamber; ceremonial feasts remain in the Grand Hall.

room_cards.name: Kitchen
room_cards.function: Rear service kitchen with hearths, worktables, and direct food routes.

room_cards.name: Pantry
room_cards.function: Dry stores and locked provisions with the normal stair to the Cellar.

room_cards.name: Sitting Room
room_cards.function: Quiet reception and conversation chamber at the front-left.

room_cards.name: Music Room
room_cards.function: Windowed music chamber with instruments and concealed cabinet exit.

room_cards.name: Privy
room_cards.function: Exterior-wall garderobe/latrine turret reached directly from the Music Room.

room_cards.name: Library
room_cards.function: Two-storey library; this lower chamber and the second-floor gallery together count as one room.

room_cards.name: 1st Floor Solar
room_cards.function: Secluded lower withdrawing chamber in the rear-left private wing.

room_cards.name: Alchemist’s Quarters
room_cards.function: Private quarters between the Solar and Study, with a false-backed wardrobe escape stair.

room_cards.name: Alchemist’s Study
room_cards.function: Laboratory with fireplaces, vents, reagents, potions, and dangerous compounds.

room_cards.name: Armory
room_cards.function: Reinforced defensive store with weapon racks and a concealed evacuation stair.

room_cards.name: Main Guest Quarters
room_cards.floor_display_name: Second Floor — Guest and Private Level
room_cards.function: Primary guest suite reached by the right-hand Grand Hall staircase and a vestibule.

room_cards.name: Den
room_cards.floor_display_name: Second Floor — Guest and Private Level
room_cards.function: Shared withdrawing chamber behind the middle landing door.

room_cards.name: Secondary Guest Quarters
room_cards.floor_display_name: Second Floor — Guest and Private Level
room_cards.function: Mirrored secondary suite reached by the left-hand Grand Hall staircase.

room_cards.name: 2nd Floor Solar
room_cards.floor_display_name: Second Floor — Guest and Private Level
room_cards.function: Private upper sitting chamber for guests and important residents.

room_cards.name: Chapel
room_cards.floor_display_name: Second Floor — Guest and Private Level
room_cards.function: Private chapel with an outer-wall altar and concealed devotional-panel passage.

room_cards.name: Attic
room_cards.function: General roof-level storage above the Hall wings, Library, and private chambers.

room_cards.name: Servant’s Quarters
room_cards.function: Separate enclosed sleeping area above the Kitchen and Pantry wing.

keep_structure.multi_floor_room_rule: The Library is one solution room and one Room card. A character standing in either its first-floor lower room or second-floor upper gallery is physically in the Library for theories and accusations.

starter_locations.opening_victim_override: Remove the selected opening victim from their normal starter cell, place the body on a legal unoccupied cell inside the sealed murder room, and spawn that character in Ghost Mode at the body.
starter_locations.spawn_safety: No random trap, active monster, or sealed no-exit lock may make a living starting cell unavoidable or inescapable.

doors.state_rule: Unlocked after match opening; relocks during Lockdown sabotage.

secret_passages.concealment: Fireplace surround or carved central wall panel
Rotating bookcase to mural-wall passage; devotional panel exit
Guest fireplace/bed alcove conceals spiral stair
Gaming cabinet/trophy case to old corner-tower guard stair; storage-chest exit

monster_spawns.hiding_place: Upper shelves and spiral stair underside
Appears to be a display skeleton in armor

automatic_lock_policy.other_authored_locks: All additional locked doors, chests, cases, stairs, and secret passages in the attached map remain locked at setup with their authored DCs.
automatic_lock_policy.randomization: Arm one otherwise untrapped eligible guest/alchemist locked door and one otherwise untrapped secret passage with facedown Trap cards. Never trap the only safe exit from a living spawn.

automatic_monster_policy.initial_state: Hidden and dormant at each authored cell until its trigger, discovery, noise, killer action, or ghost influence activates it.
automatic_monster_policy.hp_ui: Every monster has server-authoritative current HP and maximum HP. Reveal its HP bar when the monster is discovered or enters combat.
automatic_monster_policy.zero_hp: A normal monster dies at 0 HP and does not make death saves unless its card explicitly has an elite/downed exception.
